activity.notes: DEA records Escobar was a Medellin Cartel leader, surrendered June 1991 but continued directing his organization through imprisonment, escaped July 1992 and was killed by Colombia's police December 2, 1993. 1991–1993 is a SOURCE-BOUNDED late leadership interval and does NOT claim the cartel was founded in 1991 or that his criminal activity was legitimate national government. Category commerce denotes illicit commercial organization with explicit criminal designation, not approval or sovereign authority.
